github.description: A single-file Rust Windows OS launcher for the dsh (DeepSeek Harness) web UI — no WebView2, no runtime deps, just a few hundred KB. Double-click to start; close the browser and the whole process tree is torn down — no terminal to babysit, no leftover node processes holding the port, no console flash.
